core_memory.dog_age: Archie is three years old now.
core_memory.dog_history: We got him when I was in my second year of college.
core_memory.dog_presents: My parents surprised both me and my sister with him one winter break.
core_memory.dog_breed: We wanted a big, friendly breed that likes to run around and play catch.
core_memory.dog_first_meeting: When I walked through the front door and saw Archie—tiny and fluffy, wagging that little tail like it was Christmas every day—my heart melted.
